svg.title: Tekken finds boundaries before BPE
svg.desc: The sentence Hello, how are you ? becomes six text pieces: Hello, comma, space how, space are, space you and space question mark. BPE operates within each piece. Model-specific IDs and optional BOS or EOS come afterward.

g.text: D.2: boundaries first, vocabulary IDs afterward
1. Tekken preserves text and finds piece boundaries
· shows a preserved space. Concatenating all six pieces recovers the exact input.
2. BPE operates independently inside each piece
One piece → one or more token IDs • no merge crosses a piece boundary
3. Concatenate IDs, then apply the configured BOS/EOS policy once
